faqs.q: What is the Commercial Turnbuckle — Eye and Eye, Cast Steel and where is it used?
faqs.a: The Commercial Turnbuckle — Eye and Eye, Cast Steel is a eye-and-eye commercial turnbuckle to DIN 1480 that tensions a line between two eyes. It is listed in sizes M5 to M42, each size under its own Indus part number.

faqs.q: How do I read Commercial Turnbuckle — Eye and Eye, Cast Steel part numbers such as IH-LR-TB-CTEEC-M5?
faqs.a: IH-LR-TB-CTEEC-M5 is the M5 size, 0.994 kN WLL, IH-LR-TB-CTEEC-M20 the M20 size, 17.5 kN WLL and IH-LR-TB-CTEEC-M42 the M42 size. The size table lists every Indus part number with its own dimensions and rating, so quote the full part number rather than the series name.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the Commercial Turnbuckle — Eye and Eye, Cast Steel come in?
faqs.a: Sizes on the Commercial Turnbuckle — Eye and Eye, Cast Steel run M5 to M42. The size table gives each one its own Indus part number and dimensions, and the [turnbuckles & rigging screws shelf](/c/turnbuckles-rigging-screws) lists the neighbouring products.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Commercial Turnbuckle — Eye and Eye, Cast Steel?
faqs.a: Pick the size by rated load first, then the end fittings, and check the body length and overall length in the Commercial Turnbuckle — Eye and Eye, Cast Steel table against the room you have to tension in. See [our guide to choosing and tensioning a turnbuckle](/blog/how-to-choose-and-tension-a-turnbuckle).

faqs.q: What load rating does the Commercial Turnbuckle — Eye and Eye, Cast Steel carry?
faqs.a: The Commercial Turnbuckle — Eye and Eye, Cast Steel lists a working load limit of 0.995 to 59.15 kN, set per size in the table in the unit the manufacturer rates it in. The working load limit is the most the part may carry in service; proof and breaking loads are test figures and never working limits.

faqs.a: The Commercial Turnbuckle — Eye and Eye, Cast Steel is made from malleable iron and offered with these finishes: self colour, electro-galvanized. Galvanized or plated finishes protect the steel outdoors.

faqs.q: Which parts connect to the Commercial Turnbuckle — Eye and Eye, Cast Steel?
faqs.a: Connect the Commercial Turnbuckle — Eye and Eye, Cast Steel to [shackles](/c/shackles), [lifting hooks](/c/lifting-hooks) or [rigging pins](/c/rigging-pins) at the ends, and to rope through a terminal from the [sockets and terminals](/c/wire-rope-sockets-terminals).
